beats.label: title
beats.voice: Career hub cities in Asia with Ledger, part six.

beats.label: stop 1 Hong Kong
beats.voice: First, Ledger lands in Hong Kong, a hub for finance.

beats.label: stop 1 Hong Kong
beats.voice: Listings here raised about 286 billion Hong Kong dollars in 2025.

beats.label: stop 2 Shenzhen
beats.voice: Then, he crosses to Shenzhen, a hub for tech and electric cars.

beats.label: stop 2 Shenzhen
beats.voice: BYD, based here, sold over 4.6 million vehicles in 2025.

beats.label: stop 3 Hsinchu
beats.voice: Next, he flies to Hsinchu, Taiwan, a hub for chips.

beats.label: stop 3 Hsinchu
beats.voice: Its science park employed over 177,000 workers in 2024.

beats.label: stop 4 Jingdezhen
beats.voice: Then, he flies to Jingdezhen, China, a hub for porcelain.

beats.label: stop 4 Jingdezhen
beats.voice: Handmade porcelain here supported over 50,000 jobs in 2025.

beats.label: stop 5 Tyumen
beats.voice: Next, he flies to Tyumen, Russia, a hub for oil and gas.

beats.label: stop 5 Tyumen
beats.voice: Yugra, in the Tyumen region, pumps about 40 percent of Russia's oil.

beats.label: stop 6 Ulaanbaatar
beats.voice: Then, he flies to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, a hub for mining.

beats.label: stop 6 Ulaanbaatar
beats.voice: Mongolia's Oyu Tolgoi mine made 345,000 tonnes of copper in 2025.

beats.label: stop 7 Seoul
beats.voice: Next, he flies to Seoul, South Korea, a hub for cosmetics.

beats.label: stop 7 Seoul
beats.voice: Korea exported 11.4 billion dollars of cosmetics in 2025.

beats.label: stop 8 Sabae
beats.voice: Then, he hops to Sabae, Japan, a hub for eyeglass frames.

beats.label: stop 8 Sabae
beats.voice: Sabae makes about 90 percent of Japan's frames.

beats.label: stop 9 Toyota City
beats.voice: Next, he rides to Toyota City, Japan, a hub for cars.

beats.label: stop 9 Toyota City
beats.voice: Toyota, based here, employs over 390,000 people.

beats.label: stop 10 Tokyo
beats.voice: Finally, he lands in Tokyo, Japan, a hub for anime.

beats.label: stop 10 Tokyo
beats.voice: Japan's anime market reached 4.45 trillion yen in 2025.

beats.label: summary
beats.voice: So that was East and North Asia.

beats.label: summary
beats.voice: Next, part seven maps Southeast Asia.

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: To climb in these cities, you need a good business foundation.

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: Go to Edlintics.com to learn technical business skills.

stops.fact: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) reports HK$285,842.7 million raised in IPOs in 2025 (provisional), from 119 newly listed companies, up 224.9% on 2024; The Standard reports over HK$286.9 billion from 119 listings; voiced as about 286 billion. HKEX (Two Exchange Square, Central), HSBC (Hong Kong headquarters at 1 Queen's Road Central) and AIA (AIA Central, 1 Connaught Road Central) have their head offices here
stops.source: HKEX, 2025 Annual Market Statistics (figures as at 31 Dec 2025, generated 21 Jan 2026): https://www.hkex.com.hk/Market-Data/Statistics/Consolidated-Reports/Annual-Market-Statistics/2025-Annual-Market-Statistics?sc_lang=en ; The Standard, 26 Feb 2026: https://www.thestandard.com.hk/finance/article/325321/HKEX-profit-soars-36-percent-to-a-new-high

stops.fact: BYD, whose main operations are in Shenzhen, sold 4,602,436 new energy vehicles in 2025 (revenue 803.97 billion yuan)
stops.source: CnEVPost on BYD's 2025 annual report, 27 Mar 2026: https://cnevpost.com/2026/03/27/byd-2 ; Shenzhen: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shenzhen

stops.fact: Hsinchu Science Park had 177,389 workers (October 2024) and 584 companies (December 2024); TSMC, UMC and MediaTek are based in the park
Jingdezhen's handmade porcelain sector supported over 50,000 jobs in 2025, with output above 10 billion yuan

The Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug (Yugra) produces roughly 40% of Russia's oil, more than any other region (a standing share, no single year); Yugra and Yamal-Nenets (about 80% of Russia's natural gas, Novatek) lie within Tyumen Oblast and are also federal subjects in their own right; the pin is the city of Tyumen (57.15 N, 65.53 E). No company is named or shown: Western sanctions limit foreign companies there
stops.source: Meduza, 23 Jun 2026: https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/06/23/the-region-that-produces-40-of-russia-s-oil-is-now-rationing-fuel ; Reuters via Kitco, 24 Apr 2023: https://www.kitco.com/news/off-the-wire/2023-04-24/russiaaposs-oil-heartland-siberia-boosts-drilling-march-data ; Tyumen Oblast and its okrugs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyumen_Oblast ; Novatek: https://www.novatek.ru/en/about/

stops.fact: Oyu Tolgoi produced 345.2 thousand tonnes of copper in concentrates in 2025 (100% basis), up 61% on 2024; the mine is in the South Gobi, about 550 km south of the capital, and is operated by Rio Tinto, which opened an office in Ulaanbaatar in 2018; Oyu Tolgoi LLC's head office is Monnis Tower, Ulaanbaatar
stops.source: Rio Tinto, Q4 2025 operations review (SEC 6-K, 21 Jan 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/863064/000086306426000006/ex1_2025-q4results.htm ; Argus, Rio Tinto raises global copper output in 2025: https://www.argusmedia.com/en/news-and-insights/latest-market-news/2778240-rio-tinto-raises-global-copper-output-in-2025 ; Oyu Tolgoi LLC, Q4 2025 results, 29 Jan 2026: https://www.ot.mn/en/news/q4-2025-performance-results ; Rio Tinto Ulaanbaatar office: https://www.mining.com/rio-tinto-bets-big-mongolia-opens-local-office/

stops.fact: South Korea's cosmetics exports reached USD 11.4 billion in 2025, up 11.8% on 2024 (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety); Amorepacific's head office is at 100 Hangang-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, and LG H&H's head office is in Seoul
stops.source: Korea.net, 26 May 2026: https://www.korea.net/NewsFocus/Business/view?articleId=292940 ; Amorepacific HQ: https://www.apgroup.com/int/en/careers/global-network/hq/seoul.html ; LG H&H HQ move (Insight, 19 Dec 2025): https://www.insight.co.kr/news/534423

stops.fact: Sabae produces about 90% of the eyeglass frames made in Japan (City of Sabae)
stops.figureDate: City of Sabae page, read 17 November 2026

stops.fact: Toyota Motor Corporation, head office 1 Toyota-cho, Toyota City, Aichi, had 390,927 consolidated employees as of 31 March 2026

The Association of Japanese Animations puts Japan's anime market in 2025 at JPY 4.4491 trillion, up 15.8% (preliminary); Toei Animation and TMS Entertainment have their head offices in Nakano, Tokyo, and Bandai Namco Filmworks (Sunrise) is in Ogikubo, Suginami, Tokyo
stops.source: AJA release on PR Times, 30 Oct 2026: https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000007.000039770.html ; Toei Animation: https://corp.toei-anim.co.jp/en/company/outline.html ; TMS: https://www.tms-e.co.jp/company/ ; Bandai Namco Filmworks: http://www.bnfw.co.jp/en/

caption:
Career hub cities in Asia with Ledger, Part 6, covers East and North Asia with ten stops, and each stop shows one industry that city is a hub for, with a sourced fact

So you will meet Hong Kong for finance, Shenzhen for tech and electric cars, Hsinchu for chips, Jingdezhen for porcelain, Tyumen for oil and gas, Ulaanbaatar for mining, Seoul for cosmetics, Sabae for eyeglass frames, Toyota City for cars, and Tokyo for anime

Save the map for later, because Part 7 maps career hub cities across Southeast Asia

Figures as reported: HK$285,842.7 million IPO funds raised (HKEX, 2025, provisional; The Standard: over HK$286.9 billion), voiced as 'about 286 billion Hong Kong dollars'; 4,602,436 vehicles, voiced as 'over 4.6 million' (BYD, 2025); 177,389 workers, voiced as 'over 177,000' (Hsinchu Science Park, October 2024); over 50,000 jobs (Jingdezhen handmade porcelain, 2025); roughly 40% of Russia's oil (Yugra, standing share); 345.2 thousand tonnes of copper, voiced as '345,000 tonnes' (Oyu Tolgoi, 2025); USD 11.4 billion (Korea cosmetics exports, 2025); about 90% (Sabae's share of Japan's frames); 390,927 employees, voiced as 'over 390,000' (Toyota, 31 March 2026); JPY 4.4491 trillion, voiced as '4.45 trillion yen' (AJA, 2025, preliminary). Three currencies appear because each figure stays in the currency it was reported in: Hong Kong dollars for Hong Kong's listings, US dollars for Korea's exports and yen for Japan's anime market
not_verified: Hong Kong's IPO total is HKEX's provisional figure (HK$285.8 billion; The Standard gives over HK$286.9 billion), so the voice says 'about 286 billion'. Yugra's 'about 40 percent' is a standing share with no single year (Meduza 2026, Reuters 2023; one estimate implies about 36%). Oyu Tolgoi's mine is in the South Gobi, not in Ulaanbaatar; the capital holds the operator's head office (Monnis Tower, from Oyu Tolgoi's contact pages seen in search results) and Rio Tinto's Mongolia office (opened 2018; not rechecked for 2026); Oyu Tolgoi has no logo file, so it shows as a name chip. Seoul and Tokyo use country figures (Korea's cosmetics exports, Japan's anime market); Tokyo's figure is AJA's preliminary estimate. Hsinchu's worker count is from Wikipedia's Hsinchu Science Park page. LG H&H's 2026 move inside Seoul was not confirmed as finished (both addresses are in Seoul)
